commonAttemptFacts: Reference common actual attempt contract; this registry adds only operation-specific allowlisted facts and exact current groups.

types.Int32: System.Int32 signed; preserve native counts/resource/grid widths.
types.Int64: System.Int64 signed; native revision/start/HP/potential/actual quantities. Carried starts can be -1. Never narrow or cast HP to Int32.
types.Identity: System.String, native Validation.ValidId maximum96 ASCII alphanumeric/underscore/hyphen/dot; only permitted public IDs. Exact native optional empty becomes explicit absent after disclosure.
types.Code:*: Closed allowlisted public symbolic enum/code (native enums Int32); public-class selected value Cleric, public-school validated selected school codes only. No arbitrary strings/formulas.
types.Time: Exact normalized RuleTime, Int64 numerator and positive Int64 denominator, native seconds. No float/truncation.
types.Quantity:native-lot-unit: Exact normalized RuleQuantity Int64 numerator/positive Int64 denominator plus already-public native UnitId of the actually authorized lot. No guessed conversions or positive quantum.
types.GridCell:Int32,Int32: Closed pair System.Int32 X/Y, actual public grid coordinates.
types.PublicSourceRevision40: String of exactly40 source revision hex characters from an already public source-qualified definition; not checkpoint/current snapshot hash.
types.PublicSourceSha256: String of exactly64 procedure SHA256 hex characters already exposed by ExpeditionKnownSpellView; no private raw source content or fingerprint.
types.List<T>: Non-null immutable homogeneous list with explicit native/source order and current per-member authorization. Fixed protected family shape hides unauthorized existence/cardinality. No arbitrary JSON/native objects.
types.?: Explicit optional value only after predicate success; unavailable/absent is distinct from numeric zero and empty identity.

globalRules: PROPOSED ONLY. No new fact key, disclosure predicate, instance encoding or runtime implementation is accepted by this artifact. Actual GPT03 architecture concurrence is not HC-D6 acceptance.

Use current verified immutable projections. Existing view routes below name disclosure semantics, not permission to invoke legacy implementations that fold condition journals, restore/advance ledgers, validate by RNG replay, settle time, clone/execute or mutate authoritative state. Pending pure-condition-projection/cache design is a dependency. Missing verified current data => ProjectionUnavailable; never replay fallback.

Common attempt envelope/failure/receipt/revision/core-reached/clock-suspension fields reference DETAILED_RESULT_CONTRACT.md and are not replaced by these keys. No command receives a committed record on rejection; AcquireEarnedSpell has no committed route.

Evaluate current disclosure before existence, applicability, count, cause, null or value. Unauthorized family has a fixed registered Withheld shape with no hidden row count. An authorized absent optional record gives NotApplicable, not a fabricated zero stage; where explicit recorded Boolean is proposed it distinguishes actual authorized record presence only.

N_ predicates are explicit UNAPPROVED narrow proposals. Native retention below is not approved access; until approved those values stay Withheld. OPEN predicates remain Withheld even if native history stores the fact. NotRetained is reserved for historical fields actually absent from native storage.

Fresh committed native retained fields may be emitted as Retained; actual transaction-only observations are Immediate. Historical explanation uses retained original/resolving facts, never current backfill. Duplicate returns original retained facts plus separately labeled current continuation; no duplicate payment/healing/settlement.

ObservedCurrent is only CurrentObservation/CurrentContinuation per actual GPT03. Conditional future requirements belong to separate typed conditional-obligation descriptors, not fact values or availability labels in this registry.

No raw records, random seeds/states/words/natural dice, private DC/AC, condition application/source lists, arbitrary fingerprints, private declaration digests or underlying aura identity links. Existing legacy raw-history exposure is not copied into V1.

Native scalar getters from retained immutable records (ActualGain, RpAfter, PreRadianceHp, RequestedHealing) preserve native meanings; no host rule formula, requalification, cast, condition replay or future simulation is added. Any native getter depending on folding/calculation must be supplied as an approved verified fact, not trigger reads to reconstruct rules.

Unsupported third Invocation recipient remains host-unavailable while native 1-3 request capacity remains documented. Spell-specific targets, source permissions, willingness and elected Focused DC are not normalized into one broad caster route.

A.definition: Current enabled, nonrevoked seat/trusted route and exact principal-bound command authority, including the actual SeatCommandGrant narrow exception, must pass before internal exact receipt match. A bound historical receipt does not preserve revoked rights. No raw fingerprint/payload is exported. This does not grant target or inventory visibility.

O.definition: A plus subject actually belongs to the current nonrevoked own-actor projection (grant.Controls(subject)); require the applicable selected profile and exact personal subview. Opponent observation or ClockGrant is not this permission. Only existing public HP/dead/character fields are covered; Stable and StableUntil are not currently public fields.

C.definition: O(caster), ConnectedClericCasting, exact actor Casting subview. Current strain and own concentration fields only; current Guidance benefit requires the actual recipient own casting view. This is not a historical cast-history predicate.

R.definition: O(ClericRpProfile.Actor), ConnectedClericRepertoire and actual Repertoire subview. Enumerate only this owned actor KnownSpells in ordinal SpellId order. Exposed acquisition revision/origin/class/rank/school and public source revision/procedure hash remain source-qualified; genesis revision zero has no receipt.

S.definition: O(ClericRpProfile.Actor), ConnectedClericSettlement, exact ClericSettlement subview. Existing milestone revisions/path/Conviction capacity and optional current balance plus Radiance history only. Pre-LongRest absent Conviction balance is unavailable, never zero.

B.definition: S plus actual BishopEntry and Bishop settlement subview. Current earned flag/recharge and own Invocation/AuraHealing/Dispel histories exist; legacy raw native records must not cross V1. Scalar allowlist and recipient/current privacy still apply. Aura save history excludes nonparty targets.

H.definition: A plus actual selected Consecration, nonrevoked SeatGrant controlling requested Rite caster and actual Rite target, exact ObserveConsecrationHealing row. Existing base HP, Ground record, pre/post Radiance HP and final Aura HP only. This predicate is not applicable to a profile with no Consecration.

I.definition: A plus actual ProjectItems branch: MayUseInventory(owner) and controlled actual custodian; retain portable/link/cache/trap exclusions. An item identity passed by caller does not prove existence. Inventory access does not grant contamination knowledge.

V_AURA.definition: C and actual current active Detect Magic, AuraPerceived, actual opaque ObservationId match in current aura view. Respect no sight/unaware in Bishop, present/unexpired real source-proven effect, stationary observer/target, 30ft/LoE and visible outline. Only opaque ID, integer cell, Focused and permitted broad school. Never expose underlying effect/spell/rank/owner/source or hashes used to derive the ID.

V_ZONE.definition: A, selected Consecration, current controlling observer grant; actual zone Present(now) and owner==observer or native PerceivesCenter. Owner identity only if owner==observer or CanSee(owner). Existing center/radius/expiry only; public view contains no zone-command identity.

N_CAST.definition: A + C(caster) + R(caster), exact original caster receipt and current owned known-spell entry matching the cast spell/acquired revision; permit scalar own payment/cadence/elected payload metadata. No current generic cast-history view exists. Each recipient/item/effect association has its additional predicate below. Exact command text alone is not evidence a target exists.

N_CAST_TARGET.definition: N_CAST plus O(actual recipient) for character target, I(actual lot) for Purify, or V_AURA for a current aura target. Future visible-opponent-only cast targets have OPEN historical disclosure and remain Withheld. Selected Dispel historical outcome uses N_DISPEL instead of requiring the now-ended aura to remain visible.

N_EFFECT.definition: N_CAST plus O(actual target); only exact own cast effect. Current concentration/recipient Guidance views justify own effect identity and expiry, but other and historical effect fields are a new narrow extension. No arbitrary aura target effect identity. A later cause identity is separately authorized under N_CAUSE.

N_EFFECT_END.definition: N_EFFECT plus current own caster AND own target personal projections. Propose only the exact own effect terminal reason enum and time, for the full native reason set, without damage/DC/saving throw/modifier/source/attacker or hidden pending choice association. This is own spell lifecycle bookkeeping, not access to the causing actor event. Cause ID/revision separately require N_CAUSE. Any future branch whose terminal enum itself encodes a private target/source must fail closed rather than broadening this predicate.

N_SPARE_LIFE.definition: N_CAST_TARGET with actual own patient O, exact committed Spare cast, actual transaction-only post Stable Boolean. Existing own HP/dead view does not expose Stable. Propose the narrow actual stabilization result of the own paid command, without death saves, recovery die, StableUntil or private conditions. Historical current life cannot replace the absent before/after history.

N_CAUSE.definition: Underlying event predicate plus independent A for the exact later/original referenced receipt. If operator/opponent/other-seat cause is not independently authorized, withhold cause identity and metadata, without suppressing otherwise permitted own scalar outcome. Do not turn access to a party effect into access to operator receipt history.

N_ACTIVITY.definition: A + C(caster), exact owned Ground/Focus/cast/Rite/Invocation/Consecrate original receipt and selected casting/OMA profile. Only exact actor activity/origin and causally matching settlement. No existing public activity/settlement history view; current own strain view supports a narrowly proposed own accounting extension, not opponent calendars or arbitrary global epochs.

N_FOCUS.definition: A + C, exact own paid Focus receipt/record; permits retained opaque ID and own action time/origin only. BroadSchool requires N_FOCUS_SCHOOL. Internal DetectionEffectId and ObservedEffectId never exported.

N_FOCUS_SCHOOL.definition: N_FOCUS + V_AURA for the same stored opaque ObservationId; retain SchoolWithheld suppression. If aura is no longer currently perceivable/detection ends, historical school is Withheld, not NotRetained. This extends the existing current school field to a retained focus fact without revealing hidden current effects.

N_DISPEL.definition: A + B + N_CAST, exact own admitted Dispel receipt and retained BishopDispelRecord. Scalar opaque ObservationId and actual ended outcome/time only, from an originally paid own action. Do not expose legacy raw DetectionEffectId/EndedEffectId/OriginalCastId/rank/source associations. A current aura is not required to prove an already-ended own Dispel outcome.

N_RITE.definition: A + O(caster) with exact selected Cleric subview, actual Healing Rite ownership and original own receipt + O(actual patient). H already discloses a subset in Consecration; propose this same two-own-actor envelope for base/rider scalar healing and payment across earlier selected profiles. Exclude foe/other-seat patient details; actor control alone is insufficient.

N_RADIANCE.definition: N_RITE + S and actual current owned Radiance grant/path. Existing RadianceHistory exposes retained record; V1 uses scalar healing/cure preference/result only. Cure counts/IDs are excluded; no condition reconstruction. Cure occurrence is actual CureOperationId nonempty, not current absence of a condition.

N_AURA_HEAL.definition: N_RITE + B and actual current owned Aura grant. Restrict actual recipient to the existing party own-actor view. Scalar stage HP/potential, requested bonus and acquisition provenance only; no event-time opponent senses/geometry, DC or raw qualification. A recorded zero-bonus stage is distinct from no stage record.

N_INVOCATION.definition: A + B with currently earned DivineInvocation, exact own Invocation receipt. Own payment/vent/shared actual requested healing allowed. Per-recipient identity/HP/cure requires O(recipient) independently. Selected host has two party IDs; native request capacity 1-3 does not create a third host recipient. No hidden row count.

N_ZONE.definition: A + O(actual Cleric owner), selected Consecration and exact currently owned Consecrate card + original own zone receipt. Propose own historical zone/payment/deadline/end accounting only. Existing current zone observation is not an ended-zone history view. Observer-only visibility does not grant original zone receipt/identity.

N_ADVANCE.definition: A + S, and B for Bishop milestone, exact currently selected milestone for same owned Cleric and exact award/advance receipt. Historical own level/HP/feature/spell provenance extends existing milestone/owned-card/repertoire views. No arbitrary character ledger or general advancement API. Initial entitlements are not reclassified as earned.

N_HITDIE.definition: N_ADVANCE + exact bound advancement and owned actor die (ClassName, LevelOrdinal=NewTotalLevel). Die has no acquired-revision property. Acquisition link is supported by the actual atomic selected producer and validated level ledger. Historical initial Spent is not retained; current Spent is a new own-character bookkeeping disclosure proposal.

OPEN_CONTAMINATION.definition: Purify removals are retained by DestroyedByCastId/DestroyedRevision. Current inventory view provides amount/custody, not contamination knowledge. No approved means to disclose removal count/kinds/IDs/existence even to owner. Fixed Withheld family; never NotRetained.

OPEN_CONSECRATION_ATTACK.definition: Attack contribution rows retain enemy type, zone association and total modifier. No existing public contribution/event/type predicate permits this zone-owner history. Controls(owner) or current visibility alone is insufficient; trusted foe authority does not grant player zone receipt access. Fixed Withheld family with no row count; never NotRetained.

causalJoins.J0: Common exact principal-bound original command receipt, current authority and full MatchesReceipt check per DETAILED_RESULT_CONTRACT. The approved owning-Simulation verified current snapshot is the only read state. Never parse/export raw fingerprint to fabricate public fields.
causalJoins.J_CAST: J0 kind CastKnownSpell; SpellCastRecord.CommandId=receipt.Id, Revision=receipt.Revision, ActorId/TargetId/SpellId equal exact submitted fields. KnownSpellRecord.ActorId/SpellId/AcquiredRevision=cast.ActorId/SpellId/KnownAcquiredRevision; initial revision 0 is genesis, earned joins exact advancement. Event fields come from this retained cast, not current strain.
causalJoins.J_EFFECT: J_CAST and SpellEffectRecord.Id=cast.EffectId, CastId/ CastRevision=cast.CommandId/Revision, CasterId/TargetId/SpellId exact. End fields join EndCauseId+EndRevision to the actual later receipt; same-revision replacement is permitted. End cause identity requires independent current cause authority. Expiry deadline is original, not proof it has already ended.
causalJoins.J_END: J0 kind EndSpellConcentration; exact effect.EndCauseId=receipt.Id, EndRevision=receipt.Revision, CasterId=command.Actor, EndReason=Voluntary. Original cause is effect.CastId/CastRevision and exact SpellCastRecord. This free operation has no CastingActivityRecord. Effect target association needs its own predicate.
causalJoins.J_ACTIVITY: J0 plus CastingActivityRecord.CommandId/Revision=receipt.Id/Revision, Turn.ActorId=command.Actor and exact expected Kind. Under OMA additionally MagicalActivityContextRecord.CommandId/Revision/Kind match; Origin.SameAs(activity.Turn) on all ActorId/EpochId/LocalStart/GlobalStart/CarriedAdmissionRevision fields. Do not join by local start or same timestamp alone.
causalJoins.J_GROUND_SETTLE: J_ACTIVITY Kind Grounding. Non-OMA: exact CastingTurnEndRecord.Turn.SameAs(activity.Turn); OMA: exact MagicalSettlementRecord.Origin.SameAs(context.Origin), even if settlement SegmentOrdinal differs after context transition. Settlement CauseId+Revision binds its actual resolving command receipt; ordering/time are consistency checks, not sole join. No row at observation means PendingAsObserved, not historical proof of no prior settlement. No settlement is computed by reads.
causalJoins.J_FOCUS: J0 kind FocusDetectedAura; DetectMagicFocusRecord.CommandId/Revision/ActorId exact and ObservationId equals exact opaque requested target. DetectionEffectId/ObservedEffectId and original casts are proof-only joins; do not expose them. J_ACTIVITY Kind DetectFocus must agree on exact turn/time.
causalJoins.J_DISPEL: J_CAST SpellId=BishopProfile.Dispel and BishopDispelRecord.CommandId/Revision/At exact; ObservationId equals submitted opaque aura. Internal EndedEffectId binds effect with EndCauseId/EndRevision same command, EndReason Dispelled; OriginalCastId/Revision match that effect. Only allowed opaque observation/outcome scalars leave this chain.
causalJoins.J_PURIFY: J_CAST SpellId purify-food-and-drink; actual ConsumableContaminationRecord.LotId=cast.TargetId and DestroyedByCastId/DestroyedRevision=cast.CommandId/Revision. Current contamination or a now-clean lot is not evidence of past removals. Disclosure remains OPEN.
causalJoins.J_RITE: J0 kind UseHealingRite; HealingRiteRecord.CommandId/Revision/ActorId/TargetId exact. Applicable casting activity is same command/revision/actor, Kind MagicalClassAbility; use that full origin for OMA, not Rite.TurnOrdinal alone.
causalJoins.J_GROUND_HEAL: J_RITE plus ConsecratedGroundHealing.RiteCommandId/Revision/At/OwnerId/TargetId exact; ZoneCommandId joins exact owner ConsecrationZone.CommandId and its original UseConsecrate receipt. Zone provenance is a separate earlier cause, not the healing payment receipt.
causalJoins.J_RADIANCE: J_RITE plus RadianceUseRecord.RiteCommandId/Revision/ActorId/TargetId/At.Time exact. PreRadianceHp() is immediate predecessor after Ground, NOT BaseHpAfter. If CureOperationId nonempty, internal condition operation ID, stamp and EndedApplicationIds bind exact cure, without replay. Condition/source IDs are not public result values.
causalJoins.J_AURA_HEAL: J_RITE plus AuraOfFaithHealingRecord.RiteCommandId/Revision/At/Qualification.TargetId exact and Qualification.OwnerId=Rite.ActorId. Qualification.AcquiredRevision joins the owned Aura feature grant and Bishop advancement. BaseGain references base Rite.ActualGain, not recursive cumulative gain. Stage predecessor is after Radiance.
causalJoins.J_INVOCATION: J0 kind UseDivineInvocation; DivineInvocationRecord.CommandId/Revision/Turn.ActorId exact and Choice equals submitted invocation choice. Each recipient TargetId must match exactly one Choice.TargetIds entry and same record recipient. CureOperationId/EndedApplicationIds/CureAt bind the actual cure operation; cure target must be the actual selected recipient. No cross-recipient HP summation.
causalJoins.J_ZONE: J0 kind UseConsecrate; ConsecrationZone.CommandId/Revision/OwnerId and selected cell equal command. J_ACTIVITY joins same command/revision where casting/OMA active. Each retained Ground healing reference must also bind exact Rite receipt and current two-own-actor healing predicate, not just ZoneCommandId.
causalJoins.J_ZONE_END: J_ZONE plus zone.End!=Active, EndRevision matches exact unique committed receipt in validated state and native expiry/replacement writer transaction; zone stores NO EndCauseId. EndAt is recorded deadline for Expiry or actual replacement time. Do not infer cause from timestamp alone; receipt ID is proposed separately authorized metadata, not a zone native property.
causalJoins.J_MILESTONE: J0 kind AwardCharacterMilestone; CharacterMilestoneRecord.ActorId/MilestoneId=command.Actor/Target, AwardedRevision=receipt.Revision. Original objective proof must be exact selected ClericObjective or BishopDepartureProof, not arbitrary nearby progress. Record has no award timestamp.
causalJoins.J_CONSUME: J_MILESTONE plus ConsumedRevision>0; CharacterAdvancementRecord.ActorId/MilestoneId/Revision exact; exact AdvanceCharacterLevel receipt at that revision. ConsumedRevision is a later resolving event and separately authorized cause, not award-time state.
causalJoins.J_ADVANCE: J0 kind AdvanceCharacterLevel; CharacterAdvancementRecord.ActorId/MilestoneId/Revision exact; matching milestone.ConsumedRevision exact and earlier award receipt at AwardedRevision. Selected Cleric2 or Bishop3 producers only. No advancement timestamp or historical RP pool values in this record.
causalJoins.J_GRANT: J_ADVANCE plus CharacterFeatureGrantRecord.ActorId/ClassName/ClassLevel/MilestoneId/GrantedRevision equal advancement. SelectedCard and EarnedAutomaticClassFeature remain distinct. Initial/fixture origin zero is never forged into this acquisition.
causalJoins.J_KNOWN: For advancement, J_ADVANCE plus KnownSpellRecord.ActorId/ClassName/ClassLevel/LevelOrdinal/MilestoneId/AcquiredRevision equal advancement.ActorId/ClassName/ClassLevel/NewTotalLevel/MilestoneId/Revision, Origin=EarnedClassLevel, exact selected earned spell. For current repertoire, existing R returns this owned record; initial Origin=InitialClassRepertoire and AcquiredRevision=0 has no command receipt. Casting joins KnownAcquiredRevision. A rejected AcquireEarnedSpell never becomes the acquisition cause.
causalJoins.J_HITDIE: J_ADVANCE plus CharacterHitDieRecord.ActorId/ClassName/LevelOrdinal=advancement.ActorId/ClassName/NewTotalLevel. Exact producer SharedClericSettlement or SharedBishopEntry appends this die in the same actual transaction. There is NO native acquired-revision field; Spent is replaceable current state.
causalJoins.J_PATH: J_ADVANCE Cleric2 plus ClericInvocationPathRecord.ActorId/MilestoneId/AcquiredRevision exact. ConvictionCapacityRecord.PoolMilestoneId/PoolAcquiredRevision independently match the same acquisition. Bishop3 does not reacquire the Cleric2 path/capacity.
causalJoins.J_CURRENT: One approved verified current observation. No historical transaction causation is asserted. Exact actor/subview/recipient/item and current selected profile predicates apply. ObservedCurrent only with CurrentObservation or CurrentContinuation.
causalJoins.J_INTERVAL: Exact actual authoritative submission pre/post snapshots, captured once by the real transaction instrumentation, with each endpoint currently authorized. It is an AttemptInterval fact, not a forecast or proof every due effect was caused by the initiating command. On duplicate it is not a new application. No historical reconstruction.

instanceEncodingProposal.definition: Key is fixed registry string, never a target-derived key. Repeated feature/spell/Invocation-recipient facts require a typed optional PublicSubjectIdentity context (Identity) and native ordinal within the already-authorized collection. No raw object payload; no underlying aura EffectId. This context is not currently specified by ExpeditionFactV1 and must be resolved in full DTO review. Until approved, do not implement repeated key flattening or ad hoc indexed string paths. Hidden rows produce only the fixed family Withheld placeholder, never a leaked row count.
